description: qou-cds1 Step 27. CORRECTS Step 25's 'the level-k avenue is not instantiated'. `build_atom_nf` returning a 6-vector at every A is not evidence that the atom lives in H_3 — it is evidence that the production chain reduces to H_3 after every crossing (bean qou-tower), i.e. that H_3 is where the atom can be OBSERVED. The faithful object is `atom_braid_word_3A`, whose `include_inter` switch is exactly composite-vs-constituents. Binding is a DIFFERENCE of observations, so the level-k operator is the same difference taken on the OPERATORS: Delta_bind = beta_atom - beta_free. For the deuteron it factors exactly as P.(I-1).N (2.1e-40 in all 11 blocks of H_6), and since I - 1 carries sigma_2 while beta_free lives in H_3 (x) H_3, Delta_bind is genuinely H_6-valued and Step 24's branching argument does not reach it. Validated against the corpus's own `chi_lambda_of_word` to 5.4e-15. THE FINDING: convention D is the SU(2)/Temperley-Lieb trace, so omega_lambda vanishes on every partition with more than two rows — measured < 2e-16 on seven of eleven shapes, and confirmed by dimension arithmetic (720 = 6! total, 132 = Catalan(6) = dim TL_6 visible). READING CORRECTED 2026-09-01 (qou-i9gk): those 588 dimensions are the TL KERNEL and act as ZERO on the N = 2 physical space — the Schur-Weyl row cap, not a hidden sector — and the reading contradicts convention D, which is forced by the same open premise (qou-n1dj) that empties them. The binding character is LARGEST in a kernel block (chi_(3,2,1) = -9.598), an l = 3 block, so it measures what an N = 3 extension would carry. The only small eigenphases in the corpus live there: 0.0252506 in (3,2,1) and 0.0195531 in (2,2,1,1), the first values in this arc BELOW the required 0.0447444. They sum to it within 0.13 %, but that is a wall artefact: theta_2 collapses at the (2,2,1,1) ellipticity wall q_w = 1.1121238, the crossing is at q* = 1.109988469 = 1.07e7 sigma_q0 from the pin, and 'sum of two block eigenphases' has no derivation behind it.

assertions.name: level_k_operator_exists_and_is_genuinely_H6_valued
assertions.detail: Delta_bind = beta_atom - beta_free factors exactly as P.(I-1).N to 2.37e-30 in all 11 blocks; beta_free uses only gens {0,1,3,4} and is H_3 (x) H_3, while I - 1 carries sigma_2 with coefficient 1. So Delta_bind is genuinely H_6-valued and Step 24's branching argument does not reach it. CORRECTS Step 25's 'the level-k avenue is not instantiated'

assertions.name: construction_validates_against_the_corpus_character_routine
assertions.detail: my rho_lambda reproduces `chi_lambda_of_word` to 1.26e-15 in all 11 blocks — at the float64 floor of the corpus's own path, so the operator is the corpus's object and not a re-derivation of it

assertions.name: trace_is_blind_to_every_partition_with_more_than_two_rows
assertions.detail: convention D is the SU(2)/Temperley-Lieb trace, so it factors through TL_6: measured omega is ~1e-1 on the four <=2-row shapes and < 2e-16 on the other seven, and the dimension arithmetic confirms it independently — sum d^2 over all 11 is 720 = 6!, over the visible 4 is 132 = Catalan(6) = dim TL_6

assertions.name: binding_character_is_largest_in_a_tl_kernel_block
assertions.detail: the largest binding character of any block is (3, 2, 1) at -9.597856, against 0.0085637314 in the one-dimensional visible block — and it contributes nothing to the observable. 588 of 720 dimensions are the TL KERNEL — they act as ZERO on the N = 2 physical space (qou-i9gk), not a hidden sector; and (3,2,1) is an l = 3 block, so this measures what an N = 3 extension would carry

assertions.name: the_only_small_eigenphases_are_in_blind_blocks
assertions.detail: small eigenphases appear only in ['(2, 2, 1, 1)', '(3, 2, 1)'], both TL-kernel blocks, at 0.025250633 and 0.01955313 against a required 0.044744395. These are the first phases in this arc BELOW the required one — Step 25's smallest species-pair phase was 4.41x too large and Step 26's cyclotomic minimum 24.8x

assertions.name: the_sum_coincidence_is_a_degeneracy_wall_artefact
assertions.detail: the two small phases sum to 0.04480376303 against the required 0.04474439462 — 0.13 %. But theta_2 collapses to zero at the (2,2,1,1) wall q_w = 1.11212376285, so the sum sweeps through every value below it and a crossing must exist; it is at q* = 1.1099884692266, 1.07326e+7 sigma_q0 from the pin. Both q* and q_0 sit ~0.192 % below the same wall. Recorded as a target, never as a criterion: 'sum of two block eigenphases' has no derivation behind it

assertions.name: observable_share_collapses_super_exponentially_with_A
assertions.detail: the trace sees C_n of n! dimensions, n = 3A: 83.3 % at A=1, 18.3 % at A=2, 1.34 % at A=3 (4862 of 362880), 7.5e-6 % at A=6. C_n/n! ~ 4^n/n!, so the heavier the nucleus the smaller the fraction of it any corpus measurement can reach

assertions.name: corpus_word_is_a_nearest_neighbour_chain_exact_only_at_A_2
assertions.detail: `atom_braid_word_3A` places an interface at gen 3k+2 for k < A-1 in a fixed ['p']*Z + ['n']*N order — A-1 couplings where all pairs would be A(A-1)/2, a deficit of (A-1)(A-2)/2. It is ZERO at A=2, so this probe's deuteron result is exact. From A=3 it bites: permuting the arbitrary ordering (ppn / pnp / npp) moves the binding character by 22.54 %, and an all-pairs coupling would have no such dependence by symmetry

The first small eigenphases in this entire arc are in that blind sector. Their sum matches the required phase to 0.13 % at q_0, but the crossing is a degeneracy-wall artefact 1.07e7 sigma from the pin and the combination is unmotivated, so it is recorded as a target rather than a result.
